message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 in Europeans**

| Population (gnomAD v2.1.1) | Minor allele (C) frequency |
|---------------------------|-----------------------------|
| Non‑Finnish Europeans    | **≈ 0.12 (12 %)** |
| Finnish Europeans        | ≈ 0.10 (10 %) |
| All Europeans (combined) | ≈ 0.11 (11 %) |

*The “minor” allele here is the **C** allele; the major allele is **T**. The C allele is part of the APOE ε2 haplotype, which occurs at roughly 10 – 12 % frequency in most European populations.*

**Sources**

- gnomAD v2.1.1 allele frequencies (https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/)
- ExAC database (pre‑gnomAD) – similar frequencies reported for European cohorts.

**Notes**

- Frequencies can vary slightly between sub‑populations (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europeans).
- The ε2 allele (defined by rs7412 C together with rs429358 T) is the most common APOE variant in Europeans, followed by ε3 (rs7412 T/rs429358 T) and ε4 (rs7412 T/rs429358 C).

If you need more granular data (e.g., by country or ancestry group), let me know!
